info.title: ConfigContraband.Tool
info.description: Generates appsettings.schema.json from your .NET Options types so editors give live autocomplete, type checking, and required-key hints while editing appsettings.json.

options.name: --project
options.description: Project (.csproj) to analyze. Defaults to the single .csproj in the current directory.

options.name: --solution
options.description: Solution to analyze. A schema is written per project.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output schema path (single project only). Defaults to <projectDir>/appsettings.schema.json.

options.name: --check
options.description: Do not write; exit non-zero if any schema is missing or out of date (for CI).
